deferrals.upstream_title: Capture rollout budget units from response usage (#36641)
deferrals.reason: The provider-only rollout budget unit must be parsed from Responses SSE usage and propagated through TokenUsage, session, goal, memory, state, and app-server consumers while remaining absent from serialized protocol, JSON Schema, and TypeScript.  The R12 classification base has no such field or end-to-end regression, so equivalence is not claimed.
missing_prerequisites: private non-serialized TokenUsage field with serde, schemars, and TypeScript exclusion
Responses SSE unit and end-to-end fractional-number parsing evidence
all local TokenUsage constructors and accounting consumers updated without exposing provider metadata
non_claims: Existing token counts do not imply capture, propagation, or privacy parity for provider-only rollout budget units.
